d:
Kala jab junun, kalpanashilta aur adbhut pratibha ka sangam banti hai, to chhoti-si chij bhi itihas rachne ka madhyam ban jati hai. kuchh aisa hi kar dikhaya hai prasiddh saind aartist evan antarrashtriy liph aartist madhurendr kumar ne. behad simit jagah par tin pramukh rajnitik hastiyon ke chehre, pul ki sanrachna aur svagat sandesh ko itni bariki se ukerna unki asadharan kalatmak kshamta ko pradarshit karta hai.
